en.headline: EMSD finds missing lift door components in 74 more Taizoom buildings, total reaches 152
en.dek: The department said 150 private buildings and two public estates are affected, with about 180 more still to be checked, and ordered all contractors to review a decade of similar works.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said on Sunday night that inspections had identified missing door-frame components in lifts at 74 additional buildings serviced by Taizoom Elevator, bringing the total number of affected properties to 152.

Of these, 150 are private residential or commercial buildings and two are public housing estates under the Tenants Purchase Scheme. The missing components form part of the fire-resisting landing doors and help protect occupants from flames and smoke in a fire.

The department said installation of the missing parts would be carried out under its supervision, with all costs borne by the contractor. It has also ordered every registered lift contractor to review landing-door works completed over the past ten years, and is notifying the property managers and owners’ corporations of the buildings already found to be affected.

About 180 further buildings serviced by Taizoom have not yet been inspected, and the department said the total was expected to rise. It is prioritising checks on Taizoom’s work while progressively examining projects by other contractors.

zh.headline: 機電署公布再多74幢臺日升降機樓宇欠門框組件 總數增至152幢
zh.dek: 署方指受影響樓宇中150幢為私人住宅或商廈、兩幢為租者置其屋計劃屋邨，尚有約180幢未檢查，並已要求所有承辦商檢視過去十年同類工程。
body: 機電工程署周日晚上表示，巡查發現再多74幢由臺日升降機公司承辦的樓宇，其升降機未有安裝門框組件，令受影響物業總數增至152幢。
署方指出，當中150幢為私人住宅或商業樓宇，兩幢屬租者置其屋計劃下的公屋屋邨。缺失的門框組件是防火層門的一部分，有助在火警時保護乘客免受火焰及濃煙侵襲。
署方表示，補裝工程將在其監督下進行，全部費用由承辦商承擔。署方亦已指示所有註冊升降機承辦商檢視過去十年完成的層門工程，並正向已發現問題樓宇的物業管理公司及業主立案法團作出通知。
署方預計受影響數字仍會上升，因尚有約180幢由臺日服務的樓宇未完成檢查。署方正優先處理臺日的工程，同時逐步檢查其他承辦商的項目。
